description: Instagram DM automations with their numbers (conversations started and finished, link taps, emails collected), ready-made templates (turn one on with dm_automation_create template), and how many contacts they've gathered. Triggers: a comment word, a DM word, a story reply, a story mention, or any DM nothing else answers. Each has stats for the last 28 days (sent, replied, tapped and their percentages); the list puts the best performer first and automations with under 20 sends last, marked learning. trigger_kinds lists what can start one, including new_follower, which is unavailable. followups are the recent Follow up sends. Each account sends at most 190 automated DMs an hour; past that a message keeps its place and goes once the account can send again, within a day.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
